insights.summary: IonQ Inc. reported full-year 2025 revenue of $613.5 million, up 1.9% YoY, with net income of $19.2 million compared to a $23.2 million loss in 2024, driven primarily by operational improvements in gross margins (43.4% vs 39.6%) and the absence of prior-year impairment charges.
